# Winch Marketing

> Winch Marketing helps home improvement firms that sell through home visits (windows, doors, kitchens, blinds, mobility and solar) get more enquiries and more booked visits. It is run by Alex James from Northallerton, North Yorkshire, and works mainly with firms across North Yorkshire and Teesside.

## Who it helps

Owner-run home improvement and trade firms that rely on home visits and sales reps: windows and doors, kitchens, blinds, mobility and solar.

## What it does

- Tracked enquiries: every enquiry logged against its source.
- Ads that book visits: Google and Facebook ads aimed at the firm's own area.
- Booking form: postcode check, straight into the diary.
- Follow-up: reminders and quote chasers.
- Monthly report: one page covering leads, cost and jobs.

Recent work for a home-visit flooring retailer took Facebook and Google Ads from 280 to 500+ leads a week in five months, with ad spend up 5% and leads booked up from 45% to 60%.

## How it works

1. A 15-minute call about how work reaches the firm now.
2. A straight look at what to fix first.
3. Fix the biggest leak: one change that pays for itself.

## Where

Based in Northallerton. Areas served: Northallerton, Thirsk, Bedale, Stokesley, Darlington, Middlesbrough, North Yorkshire and Teesside.

## Who runs it

Alex James, founder, with 15 years in marketing. Alex also works alongside sales reps every day at a home-visit flooring company, so the person on the call is the person doing the work.
